doc.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15

title: Musicians around Chris's band; George Lewis and Hank
summary: Edna names musicians who came to the house, including Hank on bass and George Lewis on clarinet.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band

blocks.x: Yeah. And, um, would any of the musicians ever come round to your house, can you remember any of the musicians that he used to play with or anything?

Well, I know, I know a good bit of them, but now since, you know, they spread away, you know? Yes. George Lewis, he went across the river. Yeah. The other fellas Hank and then, they went uptown. Hank?
He used to play with Chris.
What, what, what was his, I don't know who that is, who is he, what did he play?
He used to play a, a bass, I think it was a bass.
Mm-hmm. Uh, what do you remember about George Lewis? I remember he used to play clarinet.
Was he good? Was he good? Mm-hmm. But where did you hear him play?
